name: youtube-mcp
description: Transcripts, search, video and channel stats, comments, playlists and trending videos from YouTube.
long_description:
Gives Claude access to YouTube.

**Transcripts** work out of the box with no API key: pull the full transcript of any public video, with optional timestamps, time ranges and translation.

**Search, stats, comments, playlists and trending** need a free YouTube Data API v3 key (Google Cloud Console > APIs & Services > enable YouTube Data API v3 > Credentials > Create API key). The free quota is 10,000 units a day; search uses 100 per call, everything else about 1.

youtube_api_key.description: Needed for search, stats, comments, playlists and trending. Transcripts work without it. Get one free in Google Cloud Console by enabling YouTube Data API v3.
